UTM Link Builder

Build perfectly formatted UTM campaign URLs with validation and one-click copy.

UTM Link Builder

Campaign-tagged URLs in seconds — validated and correctly encoded.

Open link

📖 How to use

  1. Paste your base URL (it is validated).
  2. Fill in utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign (term and content are optional).
  3. Your tagged URL builds live below.
  4. Copy it, or click "Open" to test it in a new tab.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What do the UTM parameters mean?

utm_source identifies the traffic source (e.g. newsletter), utm_medium the channel (e.g. email), and utm_campaign the promotion name. Term and content are optional extras for paid keywords and ad variants.

What if my URL already has parameters?

Yes — if your URL already has a query string, new parameters are appended with & instead of ?. Existing parameters are preserved.

Is my URL sent anywhere?

No. The URL is built entirely in your browser; nothing is sent anywhere.
